description: Land Title Settlement Department - Muththettuyaya (Block 14), Rideegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420319
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title claims and registration processes under the Registration of Title Act. It involves multiple notices calling for claims to specific land parcels in various districts, providing cadastral map references, and outlining procedures for determining land ownership. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it concerns land registration, property ownership claims, and title settlement matters.
